finding: After reducing a multi-team tie to two, engine loops into head-to-head without explicitly restarting from two-team first rung; often equivalent but not proven for every partial elimination
Engine groups common opponents by exact (wins,games), not strictly by equal conference winning percentage; unequal schedule records with equal percentages can be split
Two-team tie at No.1 yields both finalists if both eligible; ordering may differ
Head-to-head used for second berth when available
Only undefeated-against-all sweep is used when tied group did not all meet
Unresolved when ratings not supplied and prior criteria tied
